content: Runtime config/data edits breaking invariants: feature-flag best practice converges on RBAC, audit logs, encryption and flag hygiene because runtime toggles bypass code review; identity-stable canary work (arXiv 2605.28097) holds an identity-hash invariant across changes. In a safety-critical rules-as-data design, a live YAML edit is a runtime config change: it needs validation, an invariant check, a signed/versioned record, and a re-run of the safety suite before it can affect a priority.
